title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer of 1 MeV.

title: Coulomb Barrier Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly state and apply the equation for the Coulomb barrier.

title: Charge Values
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify the charges involved as approximately equal to the elementary charge.

title: Distance Estimation
description: Important Criteria: The student should estimate the nuclear radius correctly, typically around 1 fm.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Energy Range Understanding
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss the significance of energy levels in the context of nuclear physics.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as miscalculating the potential energy or using incorrect units.
